notes.title: Beta branch is live!
notes.content:
🌟 Beta Branch Now Live for Star Rising — Help Shape the Future!
Greetings adventurers,

We’re excited to announce the launch of a Beta Branch for Star Rising, our deckbuilding dungeon crawler! This new branch gives you early access to upcoming features and fixes before they hit the main game — and your feedback will be invaluable in helping us refine them.
🧪 What Is the Beta Branch?
The Beta Branch is a lightly tested version of Star Rising that includes experimental updates and improvements. It’s designed for players who want to be part of the development journey and don’t mind a few rough edges along the way.

By opting in, you’ll:

Get a sneak peek at upcoming changes

Help us catch bugs and balance issues

Directly influence the game’s evolution through your feedback
🚀 What’s New in the First Beta Build?
This initial beta update includes:

Framerate improvements across multiple dungeon environments

Audio bug fixes, including missing sound effects and looping issues

We’re actively monitoring performance and stability, so your reports will help us fine-tune these changes before they go live for everyone.
🔧 How to Access the Beta Branch[olist]
Right-click Star Rising in your Steam Library

Select Properties

Go to the Betas tab

Choose beta - public test branch from the dropdown
[/olist]
No password required — just opt in and start exploring!

Thank you for being part of this journey. Your support and input mean the world to us as we continue building Star Rising into the best deckbuilding dungeon crawler it can be.

See you in the depths, — The Star Rising Dev Team
